newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cable TV firm buys local competitor.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cable TV firm buys local competitor.

text.p: Cable TV firm Multicanal, controlled by Argentina's multimedia Grupo Clarin, Thursday said it has bought all shares of local competitor Rio de la Plata Cable Color for $83.5 million.
Multicanal told the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange it paid $41.75 million Tuesday. The rest will be paid in 12 equal, interest-free monthly instalments beginning July 1st.
Multimedia Group Clarin controls Clarin newspaper, Ole sports newspaper, TV channel Artear-Canal 13, news agency DyN, and radio stations Mitre, FM 100 and FM Top 40, among other interests.
Multicanal is one of Argentina's three major cable TV firms together with Cablevision-TCI and VCC.
